question_or_proposition: For TDS net increase effluent concentration measurements during Federal FY2025, which enforceable numeric limit applies—497 mg/L or 449 mg/L—given Section B(2)'s requirement to achieve compliance with the 449 mg/L limit '3 years after the permit effective date' read together with footnotes *10 and *11 governing the phased limits in the effluent limits table?
required_context: Effluent limits table entries for Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase on page 5
Section B - Schedule of Compliance, item 2) on page 6
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, page 6, section part_i, Section B item 2
notes: The nominated passage schedules achievement of the 449 mg/L TDS net increase concentration limit at three years after permit effective date, while the effluent limits table pairs 497 mg/L with footnote *10 (effective date through three years) and 449 mg/L with footnote *11 (beginning three years from effective date). Resolving how these provisions interact determines which numeric limit is used for FY2025 compliance comparisons.
